title: Writing: Build a Sentence II
focus: Organizar orações complexas, conectores e modificadores
verifiableTask: Montar dez frases com relações lógicas claras

content.text: Ao final da aula você consegue:
montar frases de nível B1–B2 com relações lógicas claras e ordem natural.
montar dez frases com relações lógicas claras.
Transforme a pergunta direta em indireta, falando:
Do you know where the library is?
What time does the class start?
ever / you / been / have / to Canada / ?
1. Perguntas indiretas — ordem de AFIRMAÇÃO depois da palavra interrogativa
opinião → tamanho → idade → cor → origem → material → tipo + substantivo
Pergunta direta ↗/↘ × indireta (entonação de afirmação no fim):
Do you know where it IS?
Do you know whether the professor who teaches statistics has office hours today?

options.text: Do you know where is the library?
Do you know where the library is?
Do you know where does the library is?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Do you know where the library is?

options.text: Could you tell me what time the class starts?
Could you tell me what time does the class start?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Could you tell me what time the class starts?

questions.questionText: The professor ______ teaches biology is from Chile. (pronome relativo para pessoa)

explanations.general: The professor who teaches biology is from Chile.

questions.questionText: I'll call you as ______ as I arrive. (assim que)

explanations.general: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.

options.text: a beautiful old brick building
a brick old beautiful building
an old beautiful brick building

explanations.general: Correct answer: a beautiful old brick building

questions.questionText: You can't enter ______ you have an ID. (a menos que)

explanations.general: You can't enter unless you have an ID.

I was too tired, although I was interested.

questions.questionText: I have a friend ______ studies medicine. (who/which)

explanations.general: I have a friend who studies medicine.

questions.questionText: This is the café ______ we met. (lugar)

explanations.general: This is the café where we met.

questions.questionText: Join: The test was hard. I passed.

options.text: Although the test was hard, I passed.
Because the test was hard, I passed.
Unless the test was hard, I passed.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Although the test was hard, I passed.

questions.questionText: Put in order: tell / me / could / the bus / leaves / when / you / ?

options.text: Could you tell me when does the bus leave?
Could you tell me when the bus leaves?
Could you tell me when leaves the bus?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Could you tell me when the bus leaves?

questions.questionText: She took notes so ______ she could review later.

explanations.general: She took notes so that she could review later.

options.text: The student whose laptop was stolen reported it to the police.
The student who's laptop was stolen reported it to the police.
The student which laptop was stolen reported it.

explanations.general: Correct answer: The student whose laptop was stolen reported it to the police.

content.text: Escreva a frase. Depois leia em voz alta.
“I need a quiet place to study.” →
know / do / the study rooms / you / are / where / ?
it / was / although / difficult / I / loved / it
the professor / he's / gave / who / yesterday's lecture
as / as / it / I'll / soon / finish / I / send / it
not / you / a permit / unless / have
so / I / can / that / it / later / listen to / again
the one / is / it / recommended / that / the professor / ?
in a small town / where / everybody / knows / everybody
wonder / I / it / if / opens / next week
said / she / should / that / I / take / fewer courses
o professor lê as falas, o aluno responde lendo suas frases com entonação natural.
[ ] Perguntas indiretas com ordem de afirmação?
[ ] Conectores com a relação lógica certa?
Do you know…, Could you tell me…, I wonder…
Escreva 8 frases sobre pessoas e lugares da sua vida com
although, unless, so that, as soon as, while
Embaralhe 8 frases do dia 2/3 e reorganize no dia seguinte.
Grave 1 minuto sobre sua cidade usando 3 orações relativas e 2 conectores.
Escreva um parágrafo de 80 palavras sobre um professor que você admira, com 2 relativas e 2 conectores.

questions.questionText: Put in order: know / do / the study rooms / you / are / where / ?

options.text: Do you know where the study rooms are?
Do you know where are the study rooms?
Where do you know the study rooms are?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Do you know where the study rooms are?

questions.questionText: Put in order: it / was / although / difficult / I / loved / it

options.text: Although it was difficult, I loved it.
Although was it difficult, I loved it.
It although was difficult I loved it.

explanations.B: Ordem errada: sujeito antes do verbo (it was).
explanations.general: Correct answer: Although it was difficult, I loved it.

questions.questionText: He's the professor ______ gave yesterday's lecture.

explanations.general: He's the professor who gave yesterday's lecture.

questions.questionText: You can't park here ______ you have a permit.

explanations.general: You can't park here unless you have a permit.

questions.questionText: I wonder ______ it opens next week. (se)

explanations.general: I wonder if it opens next week.

questions.questionText: Put in order: said / she / should / that / I / take / fewer courses

options.text: She said that should I take fewer courses.
She said that I should take fewer courses.
She said I that should take fewer courses.

explanations.general: Correct answer: She said that I should take fewer courses.

content.text: 1 I have a friend who studies medicine. 2 This is the café where we met. 3 I'll send the file as soon as I get home. 4 Although the test was hard, I passed. 5 You won't pass unless you study more. 6 She took notes so that she could review later.
1 Could you tell me when the bus leaves? 2 The student whose laptop was stolen reported it to the police. 3 Even though it was raining, we walked to campus.

1 Do you know where the study rooms are? 2 Although it was difficult, I loved it. 3 He's the professor who gave yesterday's lecture. 4 I'll send it as soon as I finish it. 5 Not unless you have a permit. 6 So that I can listen to it again later. 7 Is it the one that the professor recommended? 8 In a small town where everybody knows everybody. 9 I wonder if it opens next week. 10 She said that I should take fewer courses.
